name: Integrated Solar
old_description: Solar photovoltaic (PV) technology converts the sun's energy into electricity. Solar modules or “panels” can be mounted on a roof, the side of a building, or on a ground rack.
about:
Integrated Solar Applications Corp. is based in Brattleboro, Vermont. The company is celebrating its 50th anniversary, marking over five decades in the renewable energy business. Ownership details and founder names are not publicly disclosed.

The firm designs and installs solar photovoltaic arrays, geothermal heat-pump systems, air-source heat pumps, and battery energy storage for residential, commercial, municipal, and school clients. It also develops community solar projects and offers integrated system designs that combine multiple renewable technologies. The company operates as an Efficiency Vermont certified member and partners with EastRise Credit Union to provide no-money-down financing through the Heat Saver Loan and VGreen Project Loan programs.

Its customer base spans homeowners, small and large businesses, municipalities, and school districts across Vermont and New Hampshire. Notable projects include a 144 kW ground-mount array in Putney that serves more than 25 residences.

Integrated Solar emphasizes a whole-systems approach, combining solar, geothermal, heat pumps, and storage to achieve net-zero energy solutions. Its long-standing presence in the region and access to utility-backed loan programs are cited as key differentiators.

name: Integrity Energy - Solar Professionals
old_description: "The guys from Integrity Energy were terrific: knowledgeable, fast, efficient, neat. They put 30 panels on our standing seam roof in less than two days, with no disruption to our everyday routine;
about:
Integrity Energy is based in East Bethel, Vermont. Founded in 2011 by Amos Post, a former lead installer and project manager at groSolar with nine years of experience, the company began with a focus on solar photovoltaic and solar thermal installations. Post earned NABCEP PV Installation Professional certification in 2009. In 2013, John Mattern, who had worked alongside Post at groSolar and brought 15 years of carpentry experience, became a co-owner.

The company designs, installs, and services grid-tied solar PV systems, grid-tied systems with battery backup, off-grid systems, and domestic solar hot water systems. As of the latest information, Integrity Energy has installed over 3 megawatts of photovoltaic capacity across residences and small businesses in Vermont and New Hampshire. The team includes three named members: Amos Post (founder/co-owner), John Mattern (co-owner), and David Mattern (installer/IT design), who joined in 2014.

Integrity Energy serves residential homeowners and small commercial clients throughout Vermont and New Hampshire. The company works with local financial institutions such as VSECU and Mascoma Bank to offer financing options. Typical residential system costs range from $20,000 to $30,000 before federal tax incentives, with a payback period of 10 to 12 years.

The company emphasizes high workmanship, polite efficiency, and delivering quality installations at reasonable prices. Its founders' background at groSolar and NABCEP certification underpin its technical credibility.

name: Integrity Rotational Molding
old_description: Let us help bring your product vision to life with quality rotational molding solutions that fit your budget and your expectations.
about:
Integrity Rotational Molding operates from Plainfield, Indiana. The company is led by Owner/CEO Terry Stemple alongside a leadership team that includes family members Chris Stemple, Terra Stemple-Patterson, and Zach Stemple. No founding year is publicly disclosed.

The shop provides full-service rotational molding, covering design and engineering, tooling fabrication, molding, finishing, secondary operations (trimming, machining, inserts, hardware, welding, decoration), assembly, packaging, and industrial roto-lining. It runs a custom operation producing over 184 distinct parts for more than 47 customers across the United States, Canada, Germany, and Ireland.

Customers come from agricultural, automotive, waste disposal, advertising, shipping, safety, aerospace and defense, server and telecommunications, and marine and recreational sectors. Typical parts include automotive dunnage, storage tanks, material handling equipment, server housings, and complex multi-wall structures.

The company positions itself as the most referred custom rotational molder in the industry, emphasizing a proprietary problem-solving approach for tight tolerances, complex geometries, and difficult materials that other molders turn away.

name: Intel Corporation
old_description: Intel is a leading semiconductor company based in California. Designs and manufactures microprocessors, chipsets, memory and FPGA products for computing, communications and data center markets.
about:
Intel Corporation, headquartered in Santa Clara, California, was founded in 1968.

The company designs and manufactures microprocessors, chipsets, memory, and field-programmable gate array (FPGA) products. With a workforce of over 1,000 employees, Intel operates across research, development, and high-volume fabrication to serve computing, communications, and data center markets. Its platform approach engineers performance, graphics, battery life, and connectivity to work as a unified system.

Intel's products are used in computing, data center, Internet of Things (IoT), and automotive applications. Recent collaborations include providing compute platforms for Googlebook devices and serving as the official compute partner for McLaren Racing, illustrating its reach into consumer electronics and high-performance motorsports. The company also targets AI-ready networking and 5G core infrastructure with its Xeon 6 processor line.

Intel states that it "breaks barriers so builders can move faster, from prototype to global scale," and emphasizes its investment in U.S. manufacturing and AI readiness to strengthen global competitiveness.

name: Interiors By Design
old_description: Explore our 40,000 square foot showroom for instant access to all things available for purchase and take-home today.
about:
Interiors By Design operates a 40,000-square-foot showroom and design studio at 322 N 26th Street in Bismarck, North Dakota. The business traces its roots to 1967 when Florence opened Interiors by Florence on Thayer Avenue. At 15, France Splonskowski joined on commission, later purchasing the store with his wife Holly in 1987 and renaming it Interiors by France. In 2021, their children Kim and Kelly rebranded the combined residential and commercial operations—including the Office Visions sister company founded in 1993—under the current name.

The company functions as a full-service interior design retailer, offering residential and commercial design services, custom furniture specification, flooring, finishes, window treatments, and accessories. Its 40,000-square-foot facility combines showroom space with a warehouse, enabling same-day take-home purchases on stocked items. Services include complimentary design consultations, space planning, white-glove delivery and setup, and financing options.

Clients range from homeowners and builders to businesses seeking office furnishings. The firm collaborates with partner brands to supply furniture for projects of any scale, from single-room refreshes to large commercial installations.

The ownership emphasizes a client-centric mission built on long-term relationships rather than transaction volume, citing competitive pricing through brand partnerships and a free initial consultation as core differentiators.

name: International Manufacturing Services Inc
old_description: IMS has served as a solutions partner to our customers since 1974. Providing quality customer service and support while maintaining globally recognized
about:
International Manufacturing Services, Inc. (IMS) is headquartered in Portsmouth, Rhode Island. The company was founded in 1974 by former General Electric executive H. Henry Liiv and his wife Tiina, who began manufacturing thick film products in a small rented space. By 1977 they had built their first dedicated facility on one acre in rural Portsmouth, and the operation has expanded continuously over the following decades. IMS remains privately owned and family-run.

IMS designs and manufactures passive electronic components, specializing in thick film and thin film resistors, attenuators, and thermal management products such as its ThermaBridge™ and TheraPlane™ series. Engineering, R&D, manufacturing, and sales operate under one roof, enabling rapid prototyping and custom solutions. The company stocks millions of off-the-shelf chip resistors and attenuators for same-day shipping, while also offering short production lead times for custom orders. Capabilities include high voltage resistors, power resistors, high frequency terminations, 100% value testing, Sn62 leaded solder pre-tinning, and packaging services (bulk, tape and reel, waffle pack).

The company serves medical equipment, aerospace, telecommunications, defense, and instrumentation markets. In medical applications it supplies high voltage resistors, power resistors, and thermal management components. Aerospace and defense customers use its products for satellite communications, commercial space, and military requirements including 100% value testing and heat management studies. Telecommunications and data systems clients rely on high frequency, high power terminations and attenuators with impedance control. Instrumentation customers select from ultra-high megaohm resistors, precision attenuators, and ultra-low tolerance TCR devices.

IMS emphasizes its integrated structure — engineering, development, manufacturing, and sales in one facility — as the basis for short lead times and innovative products. It claims a history of industry firsts, including aluminum nitride (AlN) components, ThermaBridge™, Teraohm chip resistors, ultra-leach resistant non-magnetic termination conductors, and SZG power terminations for high frequency applications. Quality commitments are backed by ISO 9001:2015 and AS9100D certifications, and the company highlights continuous customer service since 1974.

name: Interstate Packaging
old_description: At Interstate Packaging we have a large inventory of stock shipping materials ready and available. We can help you get your product packaged and ready to ship to your customer today.
about:
Interstate Packaging operates from Denver, Colorado, where it was founded in 1991. The company remains privately held; ownership details such as family, veteran, or woman-owned status are not publicly disclosed.

The firm functions as a packaging supplies and equipment distributor, maintaining a large inventory of stock shipping materials including bubble wrap, foam, cartons, mailers, shrink film, strapping, stretch wrap, and tapes. It also supplies cold chain solutions (insulated coolers, thermal bags, gel packs), food service packaging (rigid containers, clamshells, paper liners), bags and pouches (vacuum, standup, retail, reclosable), labels, and PPE and janitorial supplies. On the equipment side, Interstate offers auto bagging machines, bag sealers, carton closing and sealing systems, case erectors, date coding and ink jet systems, flow wrappers, labelers, lidding and tray sealers, metal detection, shrink and wrap equipment, strapping machines, stretch wrappers, vacuum sealers, and vertical/horizontal form fill and seal machines. The company provides equipment service and parts, custom printing on packaging, packaging design and UPC integration, FDA/USDA compliance guidance, and sustainable packaging analysis. It operates its own fleet of delivery vehicles to provide same-day or next-day service within Colorado, with nationwide shipping capability.

Interstate serves food service operators, healthcare and food manufacturers requiring FDA/USDA compliant packaging, retail businesses, co-packers, and agricultural producers. Customers include Burrito Architect (Dis Burrito) and other unnamed companies referenced in testimonials.

The company emphasizes personalized customer service with direct access to knowledgeable staff, a combined 35 years of industry experience, and a hometown approach that prioritizes responsiveness and flexibility over automated systems.

The company curates and sells pre-packaged speaker kits designed for residential installation. Its product line includes home theater packages and multi-room audio kits, all marketed as audiophile-grade at budget-friendly prices. InwallTech does not manufacture the speakers itself; rather, it sources and assembles kits for direct-to-consumer shipment. No details about facility size, headcount, or annual volume are provided.

InwallTech serves individual homeowners and DIY installers looking for concealed audio solutions. Customer testimonials reference installations in home theaters, bathrooms, screened porches, and patio areas. The company does not list commercial, industrial, or OEM customers.

The company emphasizes ease of installation, responsive technical support, and straightforward ordering as key differentiators. Testimonials highlight the ability to reach knowledgeable staff by phone without long hold times and prompt shipping. No formal mission statement or origin story is published.
